title: 45 Volcanoes Can Be Erupting While Earth Looks Quiet
hook: 45 volcanoes can erupt while most of Earth looks calm.
closing: Volcanic activity never really stops; it only shifts location.
question: Did you know one erupts today?

segments.say: About 45 volcanoes are erupting now. A calm skyline hides a planet that never fully settles.
The Pacific Ring of Fire holds 75 percent of active volcanoes. Most danger crowds one ocean.
Only 16 are designated Decade Volcanoes. The highest-risk watch list is surprisingly short.
